## Purpose

Standalone, step-by-step walkthrough of the Drainage-Linear (DL) nitrate leaching method (Vogeler, Thomas, van der Linden & Bolan, 2020, *J. Environ. Qual.* 49(2), 338-347: `N_i [kg N/ha] = C_i [mg NO3-N/L] x D_i [mm] x 0.01`), mirroring the original `SOIL_WATER.Rmd` STEP 4 this repo's DL implementation was ported from. Calls the functions in `3_analysis/R/functions_no3_leaching.R` directly -- nothing here reimplements the method. The 4 figures in Step 6 are the pipeline's existing preliminary figures, shown as-is (not regenerated with the design system below -- see `4_outputs/README.md`).

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)
library(gt)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_soil_water.R"))
source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_management.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_no3_leaching.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_statistics.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_manuscript_figures.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "fig02_nitrate_leaching.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "utils.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Recap -- suction-cup concentration data

Quick recap of `2_preprocessing/03_soil_water_import.qmd` (see that document for the detailed EDA); this method needs `soil_water_long`.

```{r recap-soil-water}
#| message: false
soil_water_raw    <- load_soil_water_xlsx(here("1_input_data", "soil_water", "VALUE4FARM_SOIL_WATER_DATA.xlsx"))
soil_water_window <- soil_water_measurement_window(soil_water_raw)
crop_calendar     <- load_crop_calendar(here("4_outputs", "data", "field_management", "crop_calendar.csv"))
strip_crop_lookup_tbl <- lookup_strip_crop(crop_calendar, soil_water_window["start"], soil_water_window["end"])
soil_water_clean  <- clean_soil_water(soil_water_raw, strip_crop_lookup_tbl)
soil_water_long   <- reshape_soil_water_long(soil_water_clean)

cat("Measurement period:", format(soil_water_window["start"]), "-", format(soil_water_window["end"]), "\n")
```

## Step 2: Load Daisy drainage output

Daisy v7.1.3 simulated daily drainage at 1 m depth, per rotation strip (A2 = WW-SY-WW, A3 = GC-GC-SB) -- consumed here as a read-only model output (see `1_input_data/README.md`).

```{r daisy-drainage}
daisy_drain_all  <- load_daisy_drainage(here("1_input_data", "daisy_water_balance"))
daisy_drain_cols <- sort(unique(daisy_drain_all$daisy_col))
daisy_drain_cols
```

```{r drainage-summary}
daisy_drain_all |>
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date)) |>
  group_by(`Daisy column` = daisy_col, Year = year) |>
  summarise(`Drainage (mm/yr)` = round(sum(drainage_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 1), .groups = "drop") |>
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Annual drainage from Daisy at 1 m depth") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Step 3: Prepare suction-cup data (attach Daisy rotation column)

```{r prepare-sc}
sc_valid <- prepare_sc_valid(soil_water_long, daisy_drain_cols)
sc_valid |> glimpse()
```

## Step 4: Interpolate to daily concentration (LI / FC / BC)

Three interpolation methods per Vogeler et al. (2020): **LI** (linear, recommended), **FC** (forward-constant), **BC** (backward-constant).

```{r daily-conc}
dl_conc_daily <- build_dl_conc_daily(sc_valid)
dl_conc_daily |> glimpse()
```

## Step 5: Join drainage and compute daily N leaching

```{r join-drainage}
dl_leaching_daily <- join_dl_drainage(dl_conc_daily, daisy_drain_all)
dl_by_period <- aggregate_dl_by_period(dl_leaching_daily, sort(unique(sc_valid$date)))
dl_total     <- summarise_dl_total(dl_leaching_daily)
dl_total |> glimpse()
```

## Step 6: Preliminary figures (existing, unchanged)

```{r fig-method-comparison}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
plot_no3_method_comparison(dl_total)
```

```{r fig-total-by-treatment}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
plot_no3_total_by_treatment(dl_total)
```

```{r fig-cumulative}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
plot_no3_cumulative_leaching(dl_leaching_daily)
```

## Step 7: Cross-validate against Daisy's own simulated leaching

```{r daisy-validation}
daisy_no3_leaching <- load_daisy_no3_leaching(here("1_input_data", "daisy_water_balance"))
no3_dl_vs_daisy_validation <- validate_dl_vs_daisy(dl_leaching_daily, daisy_no3_leaching)
no3_dl_vs_daisy_validation |>
  kableExtra::kbl(digits = 3, caption = "Field DL leaching vs. Daisy-simulated leaching (sim = Daisy, obs = field DL)") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r fig-validation}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
plot_no3_dl_vs_daisy(dl_leaching_daily, daisy_no3_leaching, no3_dl_vs_daisy_validation)
```

## Step 8: Manuscript Figure 2 -- nitrate leaching under VAPV, rotation & management

This is the manuscript-ready figure (`3_analysis/R/fig02_nitrate_leaching.R`), distinct from Steps 4-7 above (which walk through the DL method itself). It needs `sub_strip_location` (west/centre/east), which Step 3's `prepare_sc_valid()` now carries through the whole DL pipeline alongside `location` (open field/VAPV) -- both fully balanced (384 obs each of the 6 combinations in `soil_water_long`). Assemble the same `no3_leaching_result` list `_targets.R` builds (`daily`/`by_period`/`total`) from the objects already built in Steps 3-5 above, so this section is a direct continuation rather than a re-import:

```{r fig02-build-result-list}
no3_leaching_result <- list(daily = dl_leaching_daily, by_period = dl_by_period, total = dl_total)
```

### Step 8a: fit the 3 candidate models and build each subfigure

`fig02_build_panels()` fits `fit_no3_substrip_model`, `fit_no3_management_model` and `fit_no3_model_manuscript` (see `functions_statistics.R`) and builds each of the 5 panels as a standalone ggplot object -- shown individually below before compositing. `crop_calendar` (already loaded in Step 1) supplies panel A's real sowing/harvest event markers (`fig02_rotation_events()`) -- no dates are invented.

```{r fig02-build-panels}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
fig02_panels <- fig02_build_panels(no3_leaching_result, crop_calendar = crop_calendar)
```

```{r fig02-model-summary}
tibble::tibble(
  model = c("substrip", "management", "forest"),
  formula = purrr::map_chr(fig02_panels$fits, ~ paste(deparse(stats::formula(.x)), collapse = " ")),
  n_obs = purrr::map_int(fig02_panels$fits, stats::nobs),
  converged = purrr::map_lgl(fig02_panels$fits, ~ isTRUE(.x$sdr$pdHess))
)
```

**Panel A -- cumulative leaching through time by rotation:**

```{r fig02-panel-a}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
fig02_panels$panel_a
```

**Panel B -- cumulative leaching through time by substrip position:**

```{r fig02-panel-b}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
fig02_panels$panel_b
```

**Panel C -- final cumulative leaching by substrip position:**

```{r fig02-panel-c}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5
fig02_panels$panel_c
```

**Panel D -- fertiliser x residue by rotation:**

```{r fig02-panel-d}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5
fig02_panels$panel_d
```

**Panel E -- model-effect forest plot:**

```{r fig02-panel-e}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
fig02_panels$panel_e
```

### Step 8b: assemble the composite

`fig02_assemble_composite()` takes the 5 already-built panels above and lays them out into the final manuscript figure -- the SAME function `_targets.R`'s `fig02_result` target calls internally, so this composite is identical to the one `tar_make()` produces.

```{r fig02-composite}
#| fig-width: 8.0
#| fig-height: 8.7
fig02_composite <- fig02_assemble_composite(fig02_panels)
fig02_composite
```

Save to `4_outputs/main_figures/` -- the same call `_targets.R`'s `fig02_file`/`fig02_caption_file` targets make, so this reproduces those files exactly:

```{r fig02-save}
#| message: false
save_manuscript_figure(fig02_composite, "Fig02_nitrate_leaching",
                        subdir = "main_figures", width = 8.0, height = 8.7)
save_figure_caption(fig02_caption(), "Fig02_nitrate_leaching", subdir = "main_figures")
```

### Step 8c: omnibus statistical test table

Figures show effect sizes and 95% CIs; this table is the formal-test counterpart (Type II Wald chi-square tests). Built from the SAME 3 model objects `fig02_panels$fits` already fitted in Step 8a -- `anova_glmm()` (`car::Anova()`) is a Wald test on an already-fitted model, not a refit.

```{r fig02-omnibus-table}
fig02_result_for_table <- list(
  substrip   = list(anova = as.data.frame(anova_glmm(fig02_panels$fits$substrip))),
  management = list(anova = as.data.frame(anova_glmm(fig02_panels$fits$management))),
  forest     = list(anova = as.data.frame(anova_glmm(fig02_panels$fits$forest)))
)
fig02_omnibus <- fig02_omnibus_table(fig02_result_for_table)
fig02_omnibus |>
  kableExtra::kbl(digits = 3, caption = "Figure 2: omnibus (Type II Wald chi-square) tests per model") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r fig02-omnibus-save}
#| message: false
save_report_table(gt::fmt_number(gt::gt(fig02_omnibus), columns = c(Df, Chisq, P), decimals = 3),
                   fig02_omnibus, "manuscript", "Fig02_omnibus_tests")
```
